description: Consommation annuelle définitive & régionalisée de gaz des Centrales à Cycle Combiné Gaz (zone NaTran) is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données présente par région les consommations annuelles de gaz (MWh) des Centrales à Cycle Combiné Gaz raccordées au réseau de transport de NaTran,. Les données sont des mesures brutes de quantités livrées de gaz aux points de livraison industriels. Les données sont définitives. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Consommation, Territoires et régions. Its keywords are CCCG, BIlan Gaz. The portal shows 2020-04-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
